purpose: PHD-MAIN-TRAINERR-v1 addendum 6 work na (order 4): survival over an opacity reset. Backpropagation without any parameter update; no training.

work_na.reset_rule: opacity := min(opacity, 0.01) for every Gaussian (gaussian_model.reset_opacity; exempt_mask unused: TARGET runs require judgment off)
work_na.views: every training view of the stage1 maps index (= the training cameras, asserted by jbgs_target)
work_na.photo_loss: (1 - lambda_dssim) L1(render, photo) + lambda_dssim (1 - SSIM), render not clamped (train.py 884-886); photo = fork_inputs/s61/<site>/scene_<prior>/images
work_na.depth_loss: depth_lambda x sum(|surf_depth - target| x weight over valid pixels) / pixel count (jbgs_target.Target.loss)
work_na.gradient: d loss / d opacity logit per view, each loss alone (torch.autograd.grad, retain_graph); 'raises opacity' = gradient < 0 (a descent step increases the logit)

values.views_with_gradient_share: views with a nonzero photo or depth gradient / training views
values.up_share_photo|depth: views with gradient < 0 / views with nonzero gradient of that loss

work_na.survival: uid present in the first whole-scene dump after the post-reset dump (3500 / 6500 / 9500 / 12500 for dumps every 500; 5000 for the 13-dump runs); split-replaced parents flagged from link events (how 3)
work_na.kind: 0 bound to the column patch at the centre (RESCORE columns on the centre), 1 bound to another patch, 2 released, 3 unbound
work_na.patch_group: majority group of all addendum-2 points whose patch is the Gaussian's bound patch (ties: lower code); unbound / released / no point -> '묶인 조각 없음'
work_na.bin_rule: deciles of the value over all Gaussians of the run x reset (ties merged)

logistic.transform: within run x reset percentile rank (nan -> 0.5)
logistic.fit: IRLS logistic regression with L2 1e-3 on standardized features, 50 iterations
logistic.drop_one: refit without each of the four value families (gradient views, up share, sum/abs, consistency) and without kind; AUC change

work_na.prereset_values: addendum 4/5 work na at the centre pixel over every training view containing the centre (opacity as dumped): seeing views, open views (front accumulated opacity < 0.5, front = depth < centre z - 0.05), colour weight (sum of own alpha*T), size (largest scale)
work_na.record_check: in-range Gaussians of the record_check_runs: sign of the computed per-view gradient for the view trained at each recorded iteration in (3000, 3100] (curve.jsonl camera) and of the all-view sum vs the recorded signed opacity gradient (photo, depth); opacity at the saved states 3000 and 3100 by survival
